> NightLite is a simple automatic night lamp made using an LDR to sense the ambient light and switch on an LED when the surroundings become dark. I'm trying to learn about sensors, analog input, electronics, and microcontroller programming, and this is a good start project for a beginner. I also want to make a small custom enclosure so that it can actually be used as a lamp on a desk/night stand instead of just a breadboard prototype.
